newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fujitsu shares rise to high for 1997.
newsitem.headline: Fujitsu shares rise to high for 1997.

text.p: Shares in Fujitsu Ltd rose to a high for this calendar year in heavy trade on Monday, as the stable yen against the dollar encouraged buying in blue-chip exporters, traders said.

At 0048 GMT, the share price of Japan's largest computer maker was up 20 yen at 1,500, the highest price so far this year. Trading volume was 1.458 million shares, making the issue the fourth-most actively traded one on the first section of the Tokyo exchange.
"The currency market became stable, stimulating buying in blue-chip (export-oriented) shares," said a broker at a medium-sized securities house.
